citations.assessment: Direct occurrence gives Rav Chaggai arriving from the south with a baraita supporting Rav Adda bar Ahavah. The separate Tanchuma dating is a compiler nonfinding.

notes.text: The Bavli directly attests the southern arrival and the baraita supporting Adda bar Ahavah. The chronological claim remains the compiler’s qualified report.
